high_level_description: The image shows a person sitting in the back seat of a black golf cart or utility vehicle. The person is making a peace sign with their right hand while looking towards the camera. The setting appears to be outdoors, possibly at a golf course or a similar recreational area, as indicated by the chain-link fence in the background.
